events.content:
I want a small Next.js app for keeping track of the books I'm reading.

When I open it I want to see what I'm currently reading and what I've finished. I want to add a book from a form, mark one as finished, and click through to a book to see its title, author and my notes. I'd like to be able to send someone a link to a single book.

Nothing fancy and no accounts. Skip the database, save the books to a JSON file so they're still there after a restart.
I'll build a small Next.js app that stores books in a JSON file. Let me first check the current workspace state.

24 	    if (
25 	      value &&
26 	      typeof value === 'object' &&
27 	      typeof value.output === 'string' &&
28 	      typeof value.exit_code === 'number' &&

41 	  if (!raw || !raw.trim()) return false;
42 	  try {
43 	    const value = JSON.parse(raw.trim());
44 	    return value?.kind === 'session_detail' && Array.isArray(value.history);
45 	  } catch {
46 	    return false;
47 	  }
48 	}
49 	
50 	/** @param {{model?:string}} input */
51 	export function buildFxEnvironment(input) {
52 	  const env = { ...process.env, FX_AUTO_UPGRADE: '0' };
53 	  if (input.model) env.FX_MODEL = input.model;
54 	  else delete env.FX_MODEL;

56 	}

60 	 * @returns {Promise<import('../plugin/contract.js').RunnerResult>}
61 	 */

63 	  const binary = join(input.cwd, '__agent_eval__', 'bin', 'fx');
64 	  const env = buildFxEnvironment(input);
65 	  const res = spawnSync(binary, buildFxCliArgs(input), {
66 	    cwd: input.cwd,
67 	    env,
68 	    encoding: 'utf8',
69 	    maxBuffer: 64 * 1024 * 1024,
70 	  });
71 	
72 	  const stdout = res.stdout || '';
73 	  const stderr = res.stderr || '';
74 	  const output = stdout + stderr;
75 	  const askResult = parseFxAskResult(stdout);
76 	  const processExitCode = res.status == null ? -1 : res.status;
77 	  const agentExitCode = askResult?.exit_code ?? processExitCode;
78 	
79 	  // The supported session projection is richer than fx ask's final summary.
80 	  // Fall back to the ask JSON when a session cannot be read.
81 	  let transcript = askResult ? stdout.trim() : null;
82 	  if (askResult?.session_id) {
83 	    const session = spawnSync(binary, ['session', '--id', askResult.session_id, '--json'], {
84 	      cwd: input.cwd,
85 	      env,
86 	      encoding: 'utf8',
87 	      maxBuffer: 64 * 1024 * 1024,
88 	    });
89 	    if (session.status === 0 && isFxSessionDetail(session.stdout || '')) {
90 	      transcript = session.stdout.trim();
91 	    }
92 	  }
93 	
94 	  const ok = !res.error && processExitCode === 0 && askResult?.exit_code === 0;
95 	  if (!ok) {
96 	    const errorLines = output.trim().split('\n').slice(-5).join('\n');
97 	    const error = askResult?.error || (res.error ? `Failed to run fx: ${res.error.message}` : null);
98 	    return {
99 	      ok: false,
100	      output,
101	      transcript,
102	      observedModel: askResult?.model || null,
103	      error: error || errorLines || `fx exited with code ${agentExitCode}`,
104	      agentExitCode,
105	    };
106	  }
107	
108	  return {

111	    transcript,
112	    observedModel: askResult.model || null,
113	    error: null,
114	    agentExitCode,
115	  };
116	}
